achievements.name: My Way
achievements.desc: Complete Act 4.

achievements.name: End to Major Combat Operations
achievements.desc: Complete Act 5.

achievements.name: Survivor
achievements.desc: Complete all Acts.

achievements.name: Operation Overlord II
achievements.desc: Complete Act 1 on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Ain't Life Grand?
achievements.desc: Complete Act 2 on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Cry on, Kreon!
achievements.desc: Complete Act 3 on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: The High Way
achievements.desc: Complete Act 4 on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Mission Accomplished
achievements.desc: Complete Act 5 on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: ARS Operator
achievements.desc: Complete all Acts on Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Gun Runner
achievements.desc: Scan and acquire all weapons.

achievements.name: King of the Hill
achievements.desc: Level a weapon up to maximum operational capability.

achievements.name: Fight or Flight
achievements.desc: Manually trigger AR Mode and destroy an enemy robot.

achievements.name: Adrenaline Rush
achievements.desc: Manually trigger AR Mode and destroy three enemy robots in a row.

achievements.name: Going in for the Kill
achievements.desc: Destroy ten enemy robots with melee attacks.

achievements.name: A Heartbreaker and Lifetaker
achievements.desc: Destroy 100 enemy robots with melee attacks.

achievements.name: Helloooo, Nurse
achievements.desc: Revive a friendly troop.

achievements.name: Knight in Shining White Armor
achievements.desc: Revive 20 friendly troops.

achievements.name: Death Wish
achievements.desc: Destroy three enemy robots while in damage-triggered AR Mode.

achievements.name: 40 Yard Dash
achievements.desc: Maintain a Boost dash to the limit of the ARS reactor without overheating.

achievements.name: Home Run
achievements.desc: Destroy an incoming missile or grenade.

achievements.name: Home Run God
achievements.desc: Destroy ten incoming missiles or grenades.

achievements.name: Brutality Bonus
achievements.desc: Destroy a Romanov's arms and legs, then finish it with a melee attack.

achievements.name: Romanov This!
achievements.desc: Destroy a Romanov with a melee attack.

achievements.name: The Hand of God
achievements.desc: Destroy two Romanovs in a row using only melee attacks.

achievements.name: Robots Tend to Blow Up
achievements.desc: Destroy three enemy robots at once with one hand grenade.

achievements.name: Hole-in-One
achievements.desc: Destroy a Chicane with a hand grenade.

achievements.name: Short Circuit
achievements.desc: Destroy ten enemy robots that have been disabled with an EMP emitter.

achievements.name: Two Birds with One Stone
achievements.desc: Destroy two or more enemy robots at once with the LFE gun.

achievements.name: Trick Shot
achievements.desc: Destroy three enemy robots at once with rocket launcher splash damage.

achievements.name: Flash! King of the Impossible
achievements.desc: Destroy four enemies simultaneously with the Lock-on Laser.

achievements.name: Piece by Piece
achievements.desc: Destroy the arms, head, and back of an KNRB-0 Argus robot.

achievements.name: That Ended Up Working Out Nicely
achievements.desc: After taking control of the enemy transport in Act 2-2, do not let a single enemy escape.

achievements.name: Failure Breeds Success
achievements.desc: Destroy two Argus robots in Act 2-3 while they are in bipedal mode.

achievements.name: Leibniz Defense Agency
achievements.desc: Defend the Pangloss statue in Act 3-2.

achievements.name: Tightrope Walker
achievements.desc: Destroy two cannons in Act 3-3 and complete the mission.

achievements.name: Fisher is the Other Sam
achievements.desc: Proceed on the monorail in Act 3-4 without being spotted by the enemy troops or searchlights.

achievements.name: Flyswatter
achievements.desc: Destroy all the floating turrets in Act 3-4.

achievements.name: Guardian
achievements.desc: Do not allow any friendly armor to be destroyed during Act 3-5.

achievements.name: Hurry the #@$% Up!
achievements.desc: Destroy five or more enemy transports from atop the Kreon in Act 3-7.

achievements.name: Civil Disobedience
achievements.desc: Ignore the elevator start order in Act 4-1. Instead, hold position and destroy all reinforcements.

achievements.name: Buzzard Beater
achievements.desc: Destroy the Buzzard without allowing it to reach ground level in Act 5-1.

achievements.name: Smoke 'em if ya got 'em!
achievements.desc: Destroy 10 enemies distracted by cigarettes during one mission.

achievements.name: Auld Lang Syne
achievements.desc: Destroy two enemy robots who have been distracted by a cigarette.

achievements.name: The Best of All Possible Worlds
achievements.desc: Find and fire upon all of the Pangloss statues hidden on the colony.

achievements.name: Tactical Challenger
achievements.desc: Complete all of the Tactical Challenges in VANQUISH.

achievements.name: Living Legend
achievements.desc: Complete the game without dying, regardless of difficulty level.
